SP-071.1: a1: TestRetagMovesEveryChunk (internal/rag): rag.Service.Retag moves a 3-chunk source from acme's collection to globex's; globex holds 3 of its chunks, acme 0, the store's total is unchanged, and every moved chunk keeps its point ID and vector and is labelled with the new space and the applied revision. The move reuses SP-027's copyInto (copy with vectors, count, then delete). The RPC and command that call it wait for the proto slot (see SP-071.2).

a2: TestRetagEmbedsNothing: a counting embedder records 0 calls across retags into a collection that does not exist yet, back, and into shared. TestIntegrationRetag2000 also asserts 0 embed calls on a real engine.
a3: TestRetagSearchFollowsTheSource/new_space_finds_it and /old_space_does_not: after the retag a search scoped to globex finds the source and a search scoped to acme does not (2 pass).

a4: TestRetagResumesAfterInterruption: a delete in the old collection fails after the copy, leaving the source in both; the error names no space or collection; a second retag ends with one copy in globex, 0 in acme, the total unchanged and no embedding. TestRetagEdgeCases covers refusals (no URI, no policy, bad or traversal space names, not stored, during a migration), a retag in place (stamp only), two old copies of one write ending as one, copies of different writes refused with nothing changed, a chunk with no vector kept, and a failed copy keeping the old copy. Security audit: the migration check now runs under the source lock; copies of different writes are refused rather than guessed (both fixed).
SP-071.2: a3: TestIntegrationRetag2000 (ORCH_QDRANT_BENCH=1, its own Qdrant 1.17.1 on 127.0.0.1:6481, temporary storage, collections sp-071-*): a 2,000-chunk source (384 dimensions, hybrid) moved from one space collection to another with its vectors in 2.63 s, and 2.74 s after the security-audit fixes; 0 embed calls. Threshold <= 20 s met.

a1: TestRetaggedSourceStaysForLaterWrites (internal/daemon), 3 subtests over the example policy: docs_sync (a repo doc synced into acme, retagged to personal, synced again at a new head: lands in personal, none back in acme), sources_refresh (a checkout file refreshed into acme, retagged to globex, refreshed with new content: lands in globex; a web page quarantined, retagged to personal with --confirm, refreshed: lands in personal), client_re-ingest (the operator's note, quarantined, retagged to personal: the operator's re-ingest and a personal session's re-ingest land in personal). The override is stored in orch.db (spaces_retags, migration 0031) before anything moves and applied in writePlacer.place (withRetag, spaces.ApplyOverride). RC-850 option (a): TestRetagDoesNotLetAnotherSpaceWriteIn refuses re-ingests of a retagged URI from the space it came from, another space and an unidentified caller; TestRetagIsNotBorrowedByUnplacedSessionOrFileWrites keeps quarantined session and file writes in quarantine; TestWritePlacedBeforeARetagIsRefused (internal/rag) refuses a write placed before a concurrent retag finished.

a2: TestRetagSourceRefusals (internal/daemon): agent_callers (harness session, queued task, process started by orchd, unidentified caller all get PermissionDenied through refuseNonOperator; RetagSource is also on the operator-only list in callers.go), into_public_without_confirm (refused, nothing moved, no override recorded; with confirm it moves), out_of_isolated_without_confirm (acme to personal, quarantine or globex refused; a retag in place needs nothing). TestRetagSourceRequestChecks covers bad requests, NotFound, expect_from (refused when the source is elsewhere, honored when it is there), a running migration and no policy. TestRetagResumesAtStart and TestRetagResumeFollowsTheCurrentPolicy cover resuming after an exit. TestSpacesRetagSendsTheRequestAndPrintsCounts (internal/cli) covers 'orch spaces retag'. Under D-71 the operator check is SP-025's refuseNonOperator, which this RPC calls.

Security audit of the wiring: no critical or high findings; four mediums fixed with tests: a write placed before a retag could undo it; quarantined session or file writes could borrow the override; a relabel bypassed RC-850; resume ignored the current policy. Lows L1 (policy changed mid-check), L2 (confirmation out of quarantine) and L4 (raw store error) also fixed; L3 and L5 recorded as RC-851.
